name: WOMMO - Modesty Inspired Adventure Wear For Women
desc: We are a modesty inspired adventure wear brand on a mission to help modesty-loving women spend more time exploring the outdoors. We're a humble team of outdoor enthusiasts based in the heart of Aotearoa/ New Zealand, crafting modest activewear that empowers women to embrace the great outdoors without compromising their values or style. Our story began with a simple belief: that women should be able to explore, roam, and conquer the world in attire that aligns with their modesty preferences. Fuelled by this passion, we set out on a mission to redefine adventure wear for the modern, modest woman. From scenic hikes to vibrant camping trips, relaxing beach strolls to adventurous water sports, our swimwear and adventure wear are designed to accompany women in countless of outdoorsy activities. It’s high time modesty-loving women explore on their own terms!
support: We proudly emphasise our commitment to Palestine by exclusively shipping to Palestine and not to Israel. In the coming months, we have exciting plans, including organising a community charity hike to raise funds and exploring the possibility of introducing a product where 100% of proceeds will contribute to funding humanitarian aid in Palestine.

name: Gem Modest Fashion
desc: Tired of compromising fashion for modesty? So are we... At Gem Modest Fashion, we know how important it is to stay true to yourself and your values while dressing for different occasions. That's why we offer a range of clothing options that are modest, stylish and versatile. Whether you need a professional outfit for work, a casual look for a day out with friends, or a stunning dress for a wedding, we have something for you. Our clothes are selected with high quality and taste without compromising on modesty or comfort.
support: Supporting Palestine is non-negotiable for us - these are our brothers and sisters and our children. They are us. How we are trying to help? We have made 100% of our sales going to Palestine weeks, posted and shared about Palestine and experienced the social media censoring, we contributed to fundraising dinner for Gaza. Inshallah we continue to do more.
